source: 677 Last Year’s Dream Festival
target: 677 Festum Somniorum Anni Praeteriti

source: Amandina hesitated for a few seconds before saying, “You’ve already cornered me. What choice do I have?”
target: Amandina paucos secundos dubitavit antequam dixerit: “Iam me in angulo reclusisti. Quid mihi restat?”

source: Her eyes flickered with an inexplicable excitement and curiosity as she spoke.
target: Oculi eius micaverunt inexplicabili alacritate et curiositate, dum loquebatur.

source: Her words seemed to convey a different message: I didn’t want to.
target: Verba eius alium nuntium exprimere videbantur: Nolui.

source: I had no intention of doing so.
target: Non intendebam id facere.

source: You forced me to go to Saint-Sien Cathedral!
target: Me ad Cathedralem Sancti-Sien coegisti!

source: Hurry, let’s go!
target: Festina, eamus!

source: Are you trying to “broaden your horizons?”
target: An conaris horizontes tuos ampliare?

source: Lumian criticized but didn’t expose her.
target: Lumian reprehendit, sed eam non prodidit.

source: He pointed at Hisoka’s house and said, “Before heading to Saint-Sien Cathedral, let’s check this place first.”
target: Ille Hisokae domum indicavit et dixit: “Antequam ad Cathedralem Sancti-Sien properemus, prius hunc locum inspiciamus.”

source: Amandina tersely acknowledged his words.
target: Amandina verbis eius breviter annuit.

source: “Are you trying to find the source of its uniqueness?
target: “An conaris fontem eius singularitatis invenire?

source: Give up.
target: Desine.

source: I checked during the last Dream Festival and just now, but I found nothing.
target: In ultimo Festo Somniorum Anni Praeteriti et nuper quaesivi, sed nihil inveni.

source: As she spoke, she followed Lumian at a brisk pace, anticipating what this seemingly formidable adventurer would discover.
target: Dum loquebatur, secuta est Lumianum celeriter, exspectans quid iste videbatur formidolosus adventor detegere vellet.

source: Lumian reached the second floor of Hisoka’s house, where Camus and Rhea were already waiting.
target: Lumian ad secundum tabulatum domus Hisokae pervenit, ubi Camus et Rhea iam exspectabant.

source: Surveying every corner, Lumian casually asked Amandina, “Are you familiar with Twanaku?”
target: Omnia angulos inspiciens, Lumian leniter Amandinae quaesivit: “Num Twanaku tibi notus est?”

source: Amandina wasn’t surprised by the question.
target: Amandina hac quaestione non mirata est.

source: Since she was searching for the source of the abnormality in Twanaku’s residence, she couldn’t avoid gaining a better understanding of his situation.
target: Cum fontem anomaliae in domo Twanaku quaereret, vix impedita est melioris intelligentiae de eius re adipisci.

source: She shook her head and said,
target: Caput concussit et dixit,

source: “I’m not familiar with him. I’ve only encountered him once or twice.
target: “Non eum cognosco. Eum solum semel vel bis conveni.

source: I was just a child when he lived in Tizamo.
target: Parva eram, cum ille in Tizamo habitabat.

source: Most of the time, I studied at the Iris Grammar School in Port Pylos.
target: Plurimum tempore in Schola Iris Grammaticæ Portus Pylos studebam.

source: Later, he only returned to Tizamo two or three times a year—spending a week each time.
target: Postea, ille tantum bis vel ter in anno ad Tizamo redibat, et singulis occasionibus hebdomadam manebat.

source: It was evident that Amandina had secretly learned about Twanaku.
target: Manifestum erat Amandinam Twanaku occulte cognovisse.

source: After all, she had only entered the special dream because she had slept in his house.
target: Postremo, tantum somnium speciale intraverat, quia in domo eius dormiverat.

source: She had even remained fully lucid during the Dream Festival.
target: Etiam in Festo Somniorum plene perspicua remansit.

source: Without waiting for Lumian to ask a new question, Amandina glanced at him and added, “Twanaku returns every year for the Dream Festival.
target: Sine mora ut Lumian novam quaestionem posset, Amandina eum intuita addidit: “Twanaku quotannis pro Festo Somniorum redit.”

source: “Last year, during the Dream Festival, when Robert and I returned from the black stone, we noticed someone approaching.
target: Anno praeterito, durante Festo Somniorum, cum Robertus et ego a lapide nigro redieremus, animadvertimus aliquem accedens.

source: We hid behind giant trees on both sides of the path and saw that it was Twanaku.
target: Nos post arbores gigantes in utris partibus semitae abscondimus et vidimus quod ille Twanaku esset.

source: Twanaku is indeed connected to the black boulder.
target: Twanaku re vera ad lapidem nigrum coniunctus est.

source: There are even traces of him or marks formed by extreme emotions and desires there…
target: Etiam vestigia eius aut signa ex extremis affectibus et cupiditatibus ibi formata sunt.

source: Lumian turned to Camus, who was watching him and Amandina stroll around the second floor, and pondered for a moment.
target: Lumian ad Camus se convertit, qui eum atque Amandinam circa secundum tabulatum ambulantes spectabat, et paulisper meditatus est.

source: “Which month did Twanaku’s house burn down, killing all his family members?”
target: “Quo mense domus Twanaku combusta est, interemit omnes membra familiae eius?”

source: Without waiting for Camus’s response, Amandina exclaimed excitedly, “I know, I know!”
target: Sine mora responsi a Camus, Amandina excitata exclamavit: “Scio, scio!”

source: Yes, I’m asking you. Do you think I don’t know when Twanaku transmigrated?
target: Ita, te interrogō. Pensesne me nescire, quando Twanaku transmigravit?

source: Lumian smiled at Amandina, signaling her to respond.
target: Lumian subridens Amandinae signavit, ut respondeat.

source: He had a clear and detailed understanding of Twanaku’s matters on the surface. He had deliberately asked Camus to elicit Amandina’s answer.
target: Clarissimam et accuratam notionem de rebus Twanaku habebat. Cautē Camum rogavit ut responsum Amandinae extraheretur.

source: He wanted to see if she would lie and if she had any further information.
target: Volebat videre num illa mentiret et num alias notitias haberet.

source: Amandina said smugly, “Late December. It should be a few days after the Dream Festival.”
target: Amandina superbius dixit: “Decembri sero. Paucis diebus post Festo Somniorum esse debet.”

source: As far as they knew, the Twanaku family likely perished during the Dream Festival.
target: Quam ad eorum scientiam pertinet, membra familiae Twanaku probabiliter in Festo Somniorum perierunt.

source: Upon returning to reality, their fates began to unravel, and they were taken away by the fiery disaster.
target: Cum ad rem realem redierunt, fata eorum explicari coeperunt, et ab calamitā ignitā rapti sunt.

source: The question is, why did this house leave behind an abnormality?
target: Quaestio est: cur haec domus abnormitatem reliquit?

source: What happened to the Twanaku family back then, or what had they done?
target: Quid acciderat familiae Twanaku tunc, aut quid fecerant?

source: As the bestowed of the Inevitability domain, Lumian found a term that was very Inevitability‐like to summarize the phenomenon of those who died for various reasons in the next three months after dying in the Dream Festival and returning to reality.
target: Ut electus dominii Inevitabilitatis, Lumian invenit vocabulum, vere inevitabile, ad phaenomenon eorum, qui variis causis in tribus mensibus sequentibus post mortem in Festo Somniorum ac reditionem in rem realem occiderunt, summatim describendum.

source: Reining in fate!
target: Fatum coerce!

source: Of course, he couldn’t be certain that death in the Dream Festival would lead to death in reality.
target: Scilicet, certus esse non poterat quin mors in Festo Somniorum in mortem in rem realem adduceret.

source: However, judging from Amandina’s expression and tone, Lumian believed that she thought the same.
target: Tamen, ex vultu et tono Amandinae iudicans, Lumian credidit eam idem putare.

source: After searching the second floor and finding no differences from reality, Lumian ascended the stairs to the third floor.
target: Postquam secundum tabulatum perquisivit et nullas differentias ab re reali invenit, Lumian scalas ascendit ad tertium tabulatum.

source: Amandina followed closely, her excitement showing that she finally had a chance to do what a Beyonder should do.
target: Amandina prope secuta est, eius excitatio demonstrans eam tandem occasionem habuisse id facere, quod Beyonder agere debet.

source: Lumian glanced at her and casually asked, “What left an impression on you during last year’s Dream Festival?”
target: Lumian eam intuens et leviter quaesivit: “Quid tibi in Festo Somniorum Anni Praeteriti impressionem reliquit?”

source: Amandina’s excited expression darkened, as if she had been reminded of something unpleasant.
target: Vultus Amandinae excitatus obscuratus est, quasi aliquid molestum recordata esset.

source: She covered her mouth and nose.
target: Os et nasum tegebat.

source: After a few seconds, she said, “Robert and I discovered numerous cruelly murdered individuals in the town and various plantations. Their stomachs were ripped open, and their internal organs were removed. They wore pained expressions, as if they had been tortured to death…”
target: Post paucos secundos, dixit: “Robertus et ego deteximus multos homines crudeli caede trucidatos in oppido atque in variis plantationibus. Ventres eorum aperte lacerati sunt, et viscera eorum subtrahita sunt. Vultus eorum dolore pleni erant, quasi ad mortem tormentati essent…”

source: “Serial Killer?” Camus, who had been listening intently to Louis Berry and Amandina’s conversation, blurted out.
target: “Secutor serialis?” Camus, qui attente sermonem inter Louis Berry et Amandina audiebat, repente exclamavit.

source: This reminded him of Twanaku.
target: Hoc ei de Twanaku revocavit.

source: Was this Desire Apostle venting his murderous desires during the Dream Festival to show restraint normally?
target: Num hic Apostolus Desiderii in Festo Somniorum cupiditates homicidas effundebat, ut moderationem suam normalem ostenderet?

source: So that’s how it is… Lumian roughly understood how Hisoka’s advancement ritual had been completed.
target: Ita itur… Lumian paene intellexit quomodo ritu profectionis Hisokae peractum esset.

source: Following the ritual, Hisoka had killed enough people in this realistic dream and devoured their internal organs.
target: Ritu subsequente, Hisoka in hoc somnio reali satis homines interfecit atque viscera eorum devoravit.

source: When he returned to reality, these people died one after another.
target: Cum ad rem realem redierit, hi homines uno post alium perierunt.

source: From fate’s perspective, they had indeed perished because of Hisoka’s murder.
target: Ex prospectu fati, revera perierunt propter caedem Hisokae.

source: This fulfilled the core requirements of the ritual.
target: Hoc requisita cardinalia ritu explevit.

source: Hisoka only needed to truly devour a portion of the victims’ internal organs before they were buried.
target: Hisoka solum opus habebat, ut partem veram viscera victimarum, antequam sepelirentur, devoraret.

source: He should be able to complete the ritual, consume the potion, and advance to Desire Apostle.
target: Illo oportet posse ritum perficere, potionem consumere, et ad Apostolum Desiderii progredi.

source: In reality, completing a series of murders and stealing a corpse’s internal organs were two entirely different matters!
target: In re, seriem caedes perficere et viscera corporis mortui furrari duo prorsus diversa negotia erant!

source: What puzzled Lumian was that according to Devilology, such an advancement ritual required a three‐day interval between killings.
target: Quod Lumian mirabatur, erat quod secundum Devilologiam, talis ritus profectionis intervallum trium dierum inter caedes requirebat.

source: Otherwise, it was easy to lose control.
target: Alioquin, facile moderamen amittere liceret.

source: The maximum interval couldn’t exceed nine days, or the ritual would reset.
target: Intervallum maximum novem dies superare non poterat, alioquin ritus reinciperetur.

source: Hisoka had clearly used the Dream Festival to complete all the killings in one night.
target: Hisoka plane Festo Somniorum usus est, ut omnes caedes in una nocte perficeret.

source: When he returned to reality and the primitive tribe attacked, all the “condemned” people died on the same day.
target: Cum ad rem realem redierit et tribus primitiva aggressa est, omnes “damnati” homines eodem die perierunt.

source: It didn’t drag on until the next month.
target: Non protraxit usque ad mensem sequentem.

source: Lumian believed that it was due to the April Fool’s prank.
target: Lumian credidit hoc ob iocum Aprilis Stultorum fuisse.

source: They had taken advantage of the chaos to send the deceased, whom the primitive tribe couldn’t eliminate in time, to hell.
target: Ex tumultu profecti, defunctos, quos tribus primitiva tempore delere non poterat, ad inferos mittere constituerunt.

source: This could be confirmed by the statements of the peripheral members of April Fool’s.
target: Hoc poterat confirmari per enuntiationes membrorum exterorum Aprilis Stultorum.

source: In other words, the interval of no more than nine days was satisfied, but Lumian didn’t know how Hisoka had achieved the criteria of exceeding three days.
target: In aliis dictionibus, intervallum non ultra novem dies positum erat, sed Lumian nescius erat quomodo Hisoka condicionem trium dierum excedendi assequeretur.

source: Had he used the dream’s uniqueness to avoid the three-day interval?
target: Num somnii singularitate usus fuisset, ut intervallum trium dierum vitandum?

source: When he killed someone in the dream, it hadn’t been reflected in reality, so he wouldn’t lose control so easily?
target: Cum in somnio aliquem necavit, id in re reali non reflectum erat, quare non tam facile moderamen amitteret?

source: As Lumian pondered Hisoka’s advancement ritual, he circled the rooms on the third floor.
target: Dum Lumian de ritu profectionis Hisoka meditabat, cellas in tabulato tertio circumivit.

source: After searching the room where Twanaku slept, he smiled at Amandina and said, “Apart from the serial murders, what else did you encounter?”
target: Postquam cellam, in qua Twanaku dormiebat, perquisivit, et Amandinae subridens dixit: “Praeter caedes seriales, quid aliud inveneris?”

source: Amandina pursed her lips and furrowed her brow.
target: Amandina labra contraxit et superciliis incurvatis fuerunt.

source: After a brief struggle, she grumbled, “If I cooperate, will I be awarded a medal when I return to reality?”
target: Post brevissimam contentionem, murmuravit: “Si cooperaverim, mihi insigne tribuetur cum ad rem realem redierim?”

source: Her father, Petit, had once received the Legion of Honor medal from Intis, so he was made a knight.
target: Pater eius, Petit, olim medallionem Legionis Honoris ab Intis accepit, ideo miles factus est.

source: Without waiting for Lumian’s response, Amandina continued, “I also encountered a woman who seemed like a lunatic.”
target: Nullo mora responsi Lumiani, Amandina continuavit: “Etiam mulierem occurri, quae quasi insana videbatur.”

source: “Back then, I wanted to visit the Brieu Motel to see how the gentlemen and ladies hunting in Tizamo would react in such a dream. I was looking forward to seeing their other side.
target: Tunc, volui Brieu Motel visitare, ut viderem quomodo domini et dominae, qui in Tizamo venabant, in tali somnio reagirent; exspectabam videre alteram partem eorum.

source: “When I reached one of the rooms, I heard a few people singing a strange song.
target: Cum in unam cellam perveni, paucos homines carmen insolitum canentes audivi.

source: Then, the crazy woman appeared behind Robert and me. She remained lucid.
target: Deinde, illa mulier insana post Robertum et me apparuit. Illa lucida manebat.

source: “She was quite beautiful, but she was very crazy.
target: Illa satis pulchra erat, sed valde insana.

source: Back then, I was like a child with a new toy.
target: Tunc, quasi puella eram cum novo ludo.

source: I always wanted to test my abilities.
target: Semper volui facultates meas probare.

source: I felt that with Robert’s cooperation, I could easily deal with most Beyonders.
target: Sensi, cum Roberti cooperatione, plerosque Beyonderes facile tractare posse.

source: One controlled, and the other attacked.
target: Unus moderabat, alter oppugnabatur.

source: In the end… she captured the two of us.
target: Denique, illa nos duos ceperat.

source: Robert was knocked out, stripped naked, and hung from the bell tower with a bunch of mosquitoes released beside him.
target: Robertus percussus est, nudatus, et ex turrim campanaria suspendus, cum multitudine culicum iuxta eum dimissa.

source: I—I was hung in a cesspit, descending bit by bit…
target: Ego in fossa suspendus sum, paulatim deorsum descendens…

source: At this point, Amandina appeared on the verge of vomiting.
target: Ad hoc punctum, Amandina paene vomere incipiebat.

source: In Tizamo, other than the Brieu Motel, Saint-Sien Cathedral, the police headquarters, and a few other places, no one used a flush toilet.
target: In Tizamo, praeter Brieu Motel, Cathedralem Sancti-Sien, praetorium vigilum, et paucis aliis locis, nemo latrinam aquam currentem utebatur.

source: Camus couldn’t help but sympathize with Amandina as he imagined such a scene.
target: Camus non potuit non miserari Amandinae, dum talem scaenam imaginabatur.

source: Mad Lady? Were the ones singing the peripheral members of April Fool’s who participated in the Tizamo prank?
target: Domina insana? Erantne illi, qui canebant, membra lateralia Aprilis Stultorum, qui in ioco Tizamo participaverunt?

source: Lumian circled the third-floor rooms and smiled at Amandina.
target: Lumian cellas tabulati tertii circumivit et Amandinae subridens aspexit.

source: “And then?”
target: “Et deinde?”

source: Amandina took a deep breath and said, “She also asked me why I stayed lucid. After I told her about Robert and Padre Cali, she happily ran to Saint-Sien Cathedral and completely forgot about me. After that, I gradually escaped my predicament.”
target: Amandina altum anhelitum cepit et dixit: “Etiam me quaesivit cur lucida remansissem. Postquam ei de Roberto et Padre Cali narravi, laeta ad Cathedralem Sancti-Sien cucurrit et de me omnino oblita est. Postea, paulatim ex mea incommoditate evasi.”

source: With a nod, Lumian replied, “Let’s go to Saint-Sien Cathedral now.”
target: Obsignans, Lumian respondit: “Eamus nunc ad Cathedralem Sancti-Sien!”

source: He planned to consider using the Mystery Prying Glasses and the Eye of Truth in Hisoka’s house in the dream after obtaining more information from Padre Cali and Robert.
target: Cogitabat uti Speculis Insidiantibus Mysterii et Oculo Veritatis in domo Hisokae in somnio, postquam plura a Padre Cali et Roberto acceperat.

source: “Alright.” Amandina tried her best to appear less eager, but she really wanted to see how Robert, her fiancé, interacted with Padre Cali.
target: “Recte.” Amandina conata est se minus ardenter ostendere, sed vere cupiebat videre quomodo Robertus, sponsus eius, cum Padre Cali interagirent.

source: The five of them left Hisoka’s house and hurried towards Saint-Sien Cathedral.
target: Quinque eorum domum Hisokae reliquerunt et festinanter versus Cathedralem Sancti-Sien accesserunt.

source: Lumian didn’t use teleportation because he didn’t want to waste his spirituality.
target: Lumian teleportationem non usus est, quia spiritualitatem suam non perdere volebat.

source: He couldn’t carry anyone with him in his flaming spear form either.
target: Nec quemquam secum portare poterat in forma hastae ignitae.

source: Fortunately, Tizamo wasn’t large.
target: Ex fortunā, Tizamo non ingens erat.

source: They quickly followed the shadows by the roadside and returned to the intersection where the Brieu Motel stood amidst various cries.
target: Velociter umbras iuxta viam secuti sunt et ad intersectionem redeuntem, ubi Brieu Motel inter varios clamores stabat, redierunt.

source: Lumian pointed at the Brieu Motel and warned Amandina, "Don’t go to the second floor of the Brieu Motel. Trust me, it’ll be even more terrifying than what that crazy woman put you through."
target: Lumian ad Brieu Motel indicavit et Amandina admonuit: “Noli in secundum tabulatum Brieu Motel ieris. Crede mihi, terribilius erit quam quod illa mulier insana tibi passa est.”

source: Amandina’s eyes narrowed as she said, “Okay.”
target: Amandina oculi adstricti sunt dum dixit: “Bene.”

source: The five of them turned onto another street, passing through the Bunia café, the police headquarters, and a small square before arriving outside Saint-Sien Cathedral.
target: Quinque eorum in aliam viam conversi sunt, transeundo per Bunia café, praetorium vigilum, et parvum forum, antequam extra Cathedralem Sancti-Sien pervenerunt.

source: Lumian wasn’t in a hurry to enter. He circled to the side, pried open a stained-glass window, and peered inside.
target: Lumian intrare non festinabat. Ad latus circumivit, fenestram vitream maculatam aperuit, et intus intuitus est.

source: He and Amandina, who had gathered beside him, nearly went “blind.”
target: Ille et Amandina, quae iuxta eum congregatae erant, paene caeci facti sunt.

source: In the cathedral’s hall, a handful of naked men knelt before the Eternal Blazing Sun’s altar. They were all from the Northern Continent, including Amandina’s fiancé, Robert.
target: In aula cathedralis, paucissimi viri nudi genu flexi erant coram altare Solis Aeterni Flammantis. Omnes ex Continente Septentrionali erant, inter quos Robertus, sponsus Amandinae.

source: Padre Cali, also naked, paced back and forth between Robert and the others with an excited expression, reciting, “He walks in the light, He sheds warmth, He illuminates the world…”
target: Padre Cali, quoque nudus, inter Robertum et ceteros forisque ambulabat, vultu excitato, recitans: “Ille in lumine ambulat, calorem diffundit, et mundum illuminat…”
